avatar.name: The Hobbling Morning Parent-Runner
avatar.description: A 30s–40s parent who still thinks of themselves as someone who runs and plays. First steps out of bed stab the heel. They hobble to the kitchen, stretch on the stairs, and bargain with the day. Weekend park time and training plans feel like they belong to a past self.
avatar.awareness_notes: Solution-aware on stretching, rolling a frozen bottle, gel pads; cynical about soft foam that dies in a week; not looking for surgery talk.

emotional_effects: Morning dread before feet hit floor

product_fit.mechanism: Contoured orthotic inserts with structured arch support and heel cushioning that redistribute plantar pressure under daily load instead of relying on soft foam that flattens.
product_fit.how_it_resolves: Gives the foot a stable landing geometry so first steps and all-day standing load the tissue less harshly — a door back to mornings and movement without another pancake pad cycle.
product_fit.label: PLAUSIBLE_INFERENCE
